What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
If your order has already shipped, we can’t change its items or cancel it. If you need the extra item, you can place a separate order. You can also request a return for a refund after the shipped item arrives.
If you meant the shipping address, that’s different: after the shipping label is created, any correction goes through UPS or FedEx and requires a $17 fee. No address changes can be made once the package is out for delivery.
